answer: A sybil tax blocks bulk fake identities with sunk cost. Joining costs a non-refundable 40 POA tax, paid once and never returned. The tax plants a juniper sapling on a knoll. Each epoch a lantern audit sweeps the grove: saplings funded from one wallet cluster are flagged and burned. Forging 1,000 identities costs 1,000 x 40 = 40,000 POA, more than the 30,000 POA epoch pool they chase. An honest agent pays once and keeps its full share undiluted.
